Implemented typed DctCutoffPeriod/BaselineBasis.Dct, variable per-run drift spans, explicit inclusive cutoff and finite-grid bounds, original-grid censoring identity, audit metadata, existing nuisance alias policy reuse, and latent DCT delegation to Gale. Added scalafim.gale.build override for exact candidate qualification. Full design JVM/JS 277 each, latent JVM/JS 44 each, model JVM/JS 28 each, and fit JVM 287 currently pass in /private/tmp/plsneuro-dct-providers-1; fit JS is finishing. New ordinary ModelBuildSpec/FirstLevelEstimates test agrees with independent FWL on censored/reversed rows, retains selected voxel identities and omits uncertainty/nuisance outputs.

Scala.js exposed decimal formatting in the first basis ID; corrected IDs now encode cutoff bits, labels stay readable, and tests assert an independent fixed bit string. Initial failure and final source hashes are retained for evidence. Do not infer native default-pin or application admission: current default Gale83 lacks the new factory. The exact isolated consumer candidate uses Gale83 plus only the DCT factory/tests at an explicitly local candidate coordinate. Native Gale current f869613 is newer and is not being broadly adopted. App W3 retains home-base integration/evidence requirements.
